newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AALBERTS SEES FURTHER INCREASE IN EPS.
newsitem.headline: AALBERTS SEES FURTHER INCREASE IN EPS.

text.p: Industrial holding company Aalberts Industries NV said on Thursday it expected a further increase in earnings per share in 1997.
"Barring unforeseen circumstances, the growth is also expected to continue in 1997," Aalberts said.
"Aalberts expects further growth of earnings per share," it said.
Aalberts said inventories increased as a result of acquisitions realised in 1996 and some large orders which could not be completed before the start of 1997.
"For that matter, developments of the level of inventories will receive extra attention in 1997," it said.
